description: This file defines the EmployeePictureDao class, which provides data access methods for employee pictures within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods to save an employee picture and retrieve it by employee number, extending a base DAO class.

classes.name: EmployeePictureDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for employee picture entities, providing methods to save and retrieve employee pictures.

methods.name: saveEmployeePicture
methods.description: Persists an EmpPicture object to the database and returns it.

methods.name: getEmpPictureByEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves an EmpPicture entity based on the employee number, returning null if none is found.
